proves: symbols are opaque and bindings are not inferred
explicit user trigger and request_id are mandatory
real game timing and live ACK semantics are intentionally unproved
the 0x683E branch lands on an action dispatch reading player +0x2A
one known action target subdispatches on player +0x2B
the +0x29 comparator to +0x2A action-dispatch bridge is structurally reproducible
+0x2A and +0x2B are dispatch selectors/candidate observation fields, not named move IDs
historic operator capture observed explicit RIGHT/LEFT and UP/DOWN locomotion while read-only

semanticLayer.purpose: Represent a proved command without conflating game semantics with emulator/keyboard bindings.
semanticLayer.sequence: ordered atoms with explicit edge/hold intent; compile only proved atoms to executor press/release/hold steps

timing.holdMs: must come from evidence per command; never inferred from fixtures
timing.totalDeadlineMs: executor budget only; not a game timing claim

executorNormalization.requestId: non-empty per user invocation; carried by TriggerContext, not by command plan

representativeFamilies.evidence: P1_XY_FRONTIER historical operator manipulation and coordinate response
representativeFamilies.reason: movement semantics are observed, but a deterministic live adapter/binding/timing contract is not proved
repository reverse artifacts contain no grounded direction+button command trace or timing window

subActionSelector.meaning: subdispatch selector at a known action target/candidate observation field

admissibility.rule: do not translate +0x29/+0x2A/+0x2B numeric values into named game states without evidence

signals.gameAcceptance: UNRESOLVED_LIVE_ONLY; +0x2A/+0x2B changes are candidates, not proved ACKs
signals.cleanup: deterministic safety release of logically pressed symbols in the synthetic executor

minimumLiveEvidenceRequest.whyUnavoidable: Offline repository evidence does not map any concrete direction+button sequence to a move, does not bound its game timing window, and does not prove a game-state ACK/completion/recovery signal.
minimumLiveEvidenceRequest.mode: operator-performed, passive read-only capture; no autonomous input and no RAM writes

singleBoundedSession.command: one representative known direction+button move chosen by the operator
singleBoundedSession.startState: repeatable neutral/idle state documented by video/frame marker

trials.rejectedVariation: change only one timing/order boundary at a time

record: monotonic timestamped raw direction/button press and release edges
synchronized video/frame marker sufficient to label command attempted/accepted/completed/recovered

minimumLiveEvidenceRequest.exitFact: Derive exactly one concrete command sequence, bounded ordering/timing constraints, admissible start-state predicate, and one discriminating acceptance/completion/recovery observation. If the candidate fields do not discriminate success vs rejection, report that negative result rather than widening scope.
